Why is Iran bombing Jordan’s Al-Azraq base?
items.description: Iran has increased its targeting of Jordan’s Muwaffaq Salti Air Base near Al-Azraq in recent weeks.

items.title: Syria condemns Netanyahu's 'illegal' entry into its territory
items.description: The Israeli prime minister visited Israeli troops stationed in southern Syria on Wednesday. His trip across the border drew condemnation from Damascus, which slammed it as inflammatory and a violation of the country's sovereignty.

items.description: The Saudi-led coalition in Yemen on Wednesday said the Iran-backed Houthis had launched fresh attacks on the kingdom's south, after the rebels launched an offensive seeking to control the Bab al-Mandab Strait. items.title: Syria arms depot explosion kills at least 14
items.description: The explosion struck near the Syrian city of Sarmada in Idlib province in the northwest. The Defense Ministry said the weapons and remnants from the war were being stored temporarily at the site before being relocated.

items.title: Germany's Merz attacks AfD in stormy debate after far-right election win
items.description: Germany's chancellor clashes with AfD leader Alice Weidel, saying her migration policy amounts to "ethnic cleansing" for skilled workers.

items.title: Russian Strikes Hit Ukraine, Border Crossing Near Moldova
items.description: A Russian drone attack targeted a border crossing between Ukraine and Moldova, killing two people and injuring three others, while another drone struck a residential building in Kyiv, as Moscow continues its campaign of near-continuous strikes across Ukraine.

items.title: 4 Killed in Ukrainian Attack on Novorossiysk
items.description: Russian officials said more than two dozen people were wounded during the overnight attack on the port city.

items.title: As Israel’s ‘capital of the north’ seeks to recover from war, it’s too quiet
items.description: Tens of thousands of Israelis were evacuated from their homes near the border with Lebanon. Many of them have still not returned.

items.title: Russia Says It Expects Ukraine Peace Talks to Resume as Deadly Attack Hits Kyiv
items.description: Russia says it expects trilateral talks with Ukraine and the US to resume, even as its forces launched a deadly attack on Kyiv. Peskov also welcomed US and Indian peace efforts and accused Kyiv of prolonging the war.

items.title: U.K. accuses Israeli settlers of 'ethnic cleansing' in West Bank and bans their goods
items.description: France, Canada and other countries joined the U.K. in banning goods from Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank. Israel said it would close the British Consulate among other measures.

items.title: In Gaza, women-headed households face ‘impossible choices’ to survive
items.description: In war-torn Gaza, a growing number of women-headed households face “impossible decisions” every day, amid ongoing Israeli airstrikes and still-scarce resources, UN humanitarians said on Tuesday.
